description_for_human: Upload, list and retrieve files via the Neuroforge B.R.I.D.G.E service. Use this plugin to store base64 encoded files in Neuroforge and retrieve them later.
description_for_model: Upload files encoded as base64 in a JSON body, list existing files, or retrieve stored assets from the Neuroforge B.R.I.D.G.E service. Use this plugin to manage documents and binary data on the Neuroforge system.
